ACT I OF 2013
ACT I OF 2013
SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2013.
An Act to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act,1973,
to regulate the appointments and promotions and
certain actions taken thereunder
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV,
21st February, 2013]
No.PAS/Legis-B-02/2013,
dated 21-2-2013.---The Sindh Civil Servants
(Amendment) Bill, 2013 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 7th February, 2013 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 14th February, 2013 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient to regulate certain actions
relating to appointments and promotions and whereas it is expedient to retain
the morale of the Sindh Police, which in the past has
risked the lives of their personnel and exhibited exceptional acts of gallantry
in the line of duty;
And
whereas the Provincial Assembly is in session;
Now
therefore this Bill is introduced on the floor of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh with the aim to regulate certain actions on part of
the Provincial Government of Sindh relating to
appointments and promotions granted under section 9-A of the Sindh Civil Servants Act,1973 or otherwise by the Police
Department. The Bill seeks to amend the Sindh Civil
Servants Act,1973 to extent as under:--
It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act,
2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

relating to appointments and promotions and whereas it is expedient to retain
the morale of the Sindh Police, which in the past has
risked the lives of their personnel and exhibited exceptional acts of gallantry
in the line of duty;
And
whereas the Provincial Assembly is in session;
Now
therefore this Bill is introduced on the floor of the Provincial Assembly of Sindh with the aim to regulate certain actions on part of
the Provincial Government of Sindh relating to

It
is hereby enacted as follows:-
2. Insertion
of section 23-A.---In the Sindh
Civil Servants Act,1973, after section 23, the following new section shall be
inserted:-
"23-A.
Regularization of out of turn promotions.---(1)
Notwithstanding anything contained in any law, or order or judgment of any
Court, all out of turn promotions made immediately before the commencement of
the Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Act, 2013, under
section 9-A by Government or Competent Authority or otherwise by the Police
Department shall stand regularized from the dates of such promotions.
(2) All
promotions regularized under subsection (1) above and all notifications,
proceedings, instructions or orders issued in pursuance of such promotions are
hereby affirmed and shall be deemed always to have been validly made.
(3) A
person aggrieved by any promotion regularized under subsection (1), may file an
appeal in the Sindh Service Tribunal, within thirty
days of the commencement of the Sindh Civil Servants
(Amendment) Act, 2013.
